# LayerNLooms — Complete Agency Documentation & Technical Specifications

> **Tagline**: Weaving Digital Experiences with Precision, Depth & AI.
> **URL**: https://layernlooms.com
> **Contact**: https://layernlooms.com/contact

---

## 1. Executive Summary

LayerNLooms is a premier full-stack software development agency that builds high-impact web applications, native and cross-platform mobile applications, custom AI/ML integration systems, and cloud infrastructure. We partner with ambitious startups, growing enterprises, and established global brands to design, engineer, and deploy software solutions that excel in speed, scalability, security, and user experience.

---

## 2. Full Service Catalog

### Web Development
- **Overview**: Custom web applications built for speed, responsiveness, and long-term scalability.
- **Key Capabilities**: Full-stack Next.js/React development, Progressive Web Applications (PWA), REST/GraphQL API integration, Headless Commerce, Custom CMS architecture.
- **Technologies**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Vercel, AWS.
- **Typical Delivery**: 2-6 weeks depending on project scope.

### Mobile App Development
- **Overview**: Native and cross-platform mobile solutions for iOS and Android.
- **Key Capabilities**: Native Swift & Kotlin development, React Native, Flutter, offline-first architecture, push notification pipelines, App Store & Play Store deployment.
- **Technologies**: React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, Firebase, Redux, SQLite, REST/GraphQL.

### AI & Machine Learning Solutions
- **Overview**: Practical AI integrations and custom machine learning pipelines that automate operations and create intelligent product capabilities.
- **Key Capabilities**: OpenAI / Anthropic LLM API integration, LangChain agent frameworks, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with vector search, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, custom predictive modeling.
- **Technologies**: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, Hugging Face, Pinecone, Qdrant, AWS SageMaker.

### Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
- **Overview**: Modern cloud architecture, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and automated scaling.
- **Key Capabilities**: AWS/GCP/Azure cloud migration, Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), 24/7 monitoring, security audits.
- **Technologies**: AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana.

### UI/UX Design & Design Systems
- **Overview**: User-centered UI/UX design with custom design systems that ensure visual consistency and high conversion.
- **Key Capabilities**: User research, low/high-fidelity wireframing, interactive prototyping, full design system creation (tokens, component libraries), usability testing.
- **Technologies**: Figma, Adobe XD, Framer, Tailwind CSS, Storybook.

### SaaS Analytics & Telemetry
- **Overview**: Real-time analytical dashboards, user telemetry tracking, and revenue monitoring for SaaS platforms.
- **Key Capabilities**: Event tracking pipelines, real-time data visualization, funnel & cohort analysis, multi-tenant dashboards, CSV/PDF report generation.
- **Technologies**: Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, D3.js, Chart.js, Redis, AWS.

---

## 3. Case Studies & Portfolio Highlights

### 1. ECOMM_STORE
- **URL**: https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/ecomm-store
- **Live Demo**: https://ecco-web-demo.vercel.app/
- **Category**: E-Commerce & Botanical Marketplace
- **Description**: A comprehensive digital marketplace for indoor/outdoor plants, gardening supplies, and botanical decor. Includes multi-vendor functionality ("Become Seller"), search, category filtering, user portal, and automated checkout.
- **Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Stripe.

### 2. Imgira Tools
- **URL**: https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/imgira-tools
- **Live Site**: https://www.imgira.site/
- **Category**: Design & Developer Utilities
- **Description**: A suite of 200+ browser-based tools operating zero-friction (no sign-up required). Includes image processing algorithms (edge detection, channel splitters), GIF converters, 3D text generators, ASCII art transformers, and Pythagoras fractal simulators.
- **Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Canvas API, WebAssembly, Tailwind CSS.

### 3. Temp Nova
- **URL**: https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/temp-nova
- **Live Site**: https://www.temp-nova.com/
- **Category**: Digital Privacy & Security Utilities
- **Description**: Anonymous digital identity suite providing disposable email addresses, virtual temporary phone numbers for SMS/OTP verification, temp username generation, and self-destructing encrypted notes on a stateless zero-retention backend.
- **Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS.

### 4. Explore with Unity
- **URL**: https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/explore-with-unity
- **Live Site**: https://www.explorewithunity.in/
- **Category**: Social Travel Platform
- **Description**: Community-driven travel journaling platform allowing users to document trips, publish digital travelogues, follow fellow travelers, and discover destination itineraries.
- **Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Firebase, Socket.io, Tailwind CSS.

### 5. Softivra
- **URL**: https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/softivra
- **Live Site**: https://softivra.vercel.app
- **Category**: Design Systems & Web Agency Platform
- **Description**: High-performance web agency website and design system incorporating dynamic WebGL visual elements, smooth page transitions, and modular UI components.
- **Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, Tailwind CSS.

### 6. Neritic Wellness
- **URL**: https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/neritic-wellness
- **Live Site**: https://neritic-dashboard.vercel.app
- **Category**: E-Commerce Admin & Analytics Dashboard
- **Description**: Comprehensive admin platform featuring product catalog CRUD, order tracking, real-time revenue telemetry, role-based user access controls, and report downloads.
- **Stack**: React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Chart.js, Tailwind CSS, Redis, Docker.

## 4. Technical Blog & Published Insights

1. **The Future of Web Development in 2026**: Trends in AI coding assistance, edge-first SSR, WebAssembly runtimes, and WebGPU immersive frontends. (https://layernlooms.com/blog/future-of-web-development-2026)
2. **Building Scalable Microservices with Node.js**: Service decomposition, API gateway patterns, Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, and ELK stack observability. (https://layernlooms.com/blog/building-scalable-microservices-nodejs)
3. **AI-Powered Applications: A Developer's Guide**: Integrating LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and evaluation frameworks into production apps. (https://layernlooms.com/blog/ai-powered-applications-developer-guide)
4. **Why Your Business Needs a Progressive Web App**: Business metrics, offline caching strategies, service worker patterns, and PWA case studies. (https://layernlooms.com/blog/why-your-business-needs-progressive-web-app)
5. **The Complete Guide to Cloud Migration**: Step-by-step framework for 6 R's cloud migration, security posture, and AWS/Azure cloud cost optimization. (https://layernlooms.com/blog/complete-guide-cloud-migration)
6. **Modern Frontend Development with React & Next.js**: React Server Components (RSC), Server Actions, Suspense streaming, and state management patterns. (https://layernlooms.com/blog/modern-frontend-development-react-nextjs)
7. **Cybersecurity Best Practices for Web Applications**: Protecting against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, HTTPS/HSTS, Content Security Policy (CSP), and session security. (https://layernlooms.com/blog/cybersecurity-best-practices-web-applications)
8. **The Rise of Low-Code and No-Code Platforms**: Strategic guide on when to leverage low-code tools versus custom software engineering. (https://layernlooms.com/blog/rise-of-low-code-no-code-platforms)
9. **Optimizing Web Performance for Better User Experience**: Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) optimization, next-gen image formats, and bundle reduction. (https://layernlooms.com/blog/optimizing-web-performance)
10. **How to Choose the Right Tech Stack for Your Project**: Evaluation framework for matching business goals, scale, and team capabilities to technical architecture. (https://layernlooms.com/blog/how-to-choose-right-tech-stack)
